summary.text: Matthew Szalaj is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 84, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served on the Shelby County Board of Commissioners, District 9, from March to September 2026.

paragraphs.text: Matthew Szalaj was appointed to the Shelby County Board of Commissioners, District 9, on March 9, 2026, to replace Edmund Ford Jr.
He left the board on September 1, 2026, and did not run for re-election to that seat in 2026.
